_comment: Versioned, additive media catalogue for the Model Hub. A family is 'supported' ONLY when PaRuX owns a workflow template for it (registryFamily points at a supported media-companion-registry family); everything else is 'resolver_only' with an honest reason and is shown but never offered for download. 'tier' is a DECLARED quality tier (1-5) chosen by the catalogue author from public model-family positioning; it is not a benchmark and is always labelled declared in the UI. sizeBytes is set ONLY when listingVerified is true (checked against the repository listing); otherwise size is derived from parametersBillion x precision and labelled so. 'license' is the publisher's declared licence shown as a hint; the real licence evidence and consent come from the download consent flow. 'lane' is standard unless the repository itself declares an uncensored/abliterated nature, and an uncensored entry must carry laneEvidence. No uncensored media checkpoint has been verified against a repository listing yet, so that lane is intentionally empty rather than guessed.

variants.title: Qwen-Image (fp8)
variants.baseCompat: Qwen-Image text-to-image graph (20 steps, CFG 4) with the qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled text encoder and qwen_image_vae. About 20 GB of weights: more than a 16 GB card holds, so ComfyUI offloads part of them to system RAM (slower; not yet timed on this PC).

families.reason: The GGUF build needs a GGUF loader node that PaRuX does not install or validate, so it is listed only; the supported Qwen-Image fp8 checkpoint covers the same model.

variants.title: Qwen-Image (GGUF Q4_K_M)
variants.baseCompat: Needs a GGUF loader node and the qwen_2.5_vl_7b text encoder.

variants.title: Qwen-Image-Edit (fp8)
variants.baseCompat: Qwen-Image-Edit instruction-edit graph (source image scaled to 1 megapixel, 20 steps, CFG 2.5) with the same qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled text encoder and qwen_image_vae as Qwen-Image, so installing both shares those two files. PaRuX cannot tell these weights from Qwen-Image's by their header: assign this file to editing, not the text-to-image checkpoint. About 20 GB of weights, offloaded to system RAM on a 16 GB card (slower; not yet timed on this PC).

families.reason: No Wan 2.2 14B workflow template (two-expert sampling, GGUF loader, audio-driven S2V) could be validated against a real ComfyUI in this build, so PaRuX does not run it yet.

variants.title: Wan 2.2 I2V 14B (fp8, high-noise expert)
variants.baseCompat: Two experts run one after the other; both files are needed. Size shown is for one expert.

variants.title: Wan 2.2 T2V 14B (fp8, high-noise expert)
variants.baseCompat: Two experts run one after the other; both files are needed. Size shown is for one expert.

variants.title: Wan 2.2 I2V 14B (GGUF Q4_K_M, high-noise expert)
variants.baseCompat: Needs a GGUF loader node and the matching low-noise expert.

variants.title: Wan 2.2 S2V 14B (audio-driven, fp8)
variants.baseCompat: Needs an audio encoder in addition to the text encoder and VAE.

families.reason: PaRuX does not run LTX-Video yet. Its checkpoint embeds its own VAE and ComfyUI loads it as a full checkpoint, while PaRuX's video workflow takes a diffusion model plus a separate VAE file and drives the Wan graph's latent, sampler and start-image nodes. An LTX graph needs its own video runner contract (including image-to-video continuation) before it can be offered.
